title: Must Also Be Hidden

facts.claim: OCI layer removals are represented by empty regular-file whiteout entries named .wh. plus the removed basename.
facts.source_selector: turn770118view0 official OCI Image Specification v1.1.1 layer whiteout section
facts.draft_exact_string: Under the OCI Image Specification, that `.wh.` entry is a whiteout for the lower-layer objection; applying it removes the objection from the merged filesystem, and the whiteout marker itself must also be hidden.

facts.claim: A whiteout applies only to lower layers and is itself hidden after layer application.
facts.source_selector: turn770118view0 official OCI Image Specification v1.1.1 whiteout scope and hiding rules
facts.draft_exact_string: Under the OCI Image Specification, that `.wh.` entry is a whiteout for the lower-layer objection; applying it removes the objection from the merged filesystem, and the whiteout marker itself must also be hidden.

facts.claim: OCI image manifests list filesystem layers in stack order, beginning with the base layer.
facts.source_selector: turn770118view2 official OCI Image Specification v1.1.1 manifest layer ordering
facts.draft_exact_string: The final merged view therefore contains neither path, while the image manifest still references both content-addressed layer blobs in stack order.

facts.claim: OCI image-layout blobs are content-addressed and must match the digest encoded by their descriptor and path.
facts.source_selector: turn770118view1 official OCI Image Specification v1.1.1 image-layout blob rules
facts.draft_exact_string: The final merged view therefore contains neither path, while the image manifest still references both content-addressed layer blobs in stack order.

facts.claim: The official release page identified OCI Image Specification v1.1.1, dated March 3, 2025, as latest at the June 18, 2026 access time.
facts.draft_exact_string: The release page identified v1.1.1, dated March 3, 2025, as the latest release when checked on June 18, 2026.

facts.claim: An OCI layer tar must not duplicate a file path.
facts.source_selector: turn770118view0 official OCI Image Specification v1.1.1 layer changeset requirements
